candidate.title: scATAC-Seq
candidate.scope: Two explicitly labeled alternatives in the assigned Illumina schematic: combinatorial cellular indexing of nuclei and individual-cell microfluidic scATAC-Seq. The middle and bottom rows are separate routes from cell suspensions to pooled, barcoded genomic DNA libraries that sample chromatin accessibility. The three well icons in each cell-indexing round are schematic parallel examples, not a specified plate size; each independently processed depicted well is retained as its own local operation. The microfluidic row shows one representative cell route and pooling with libraries from other cells. The initial Single cell-to-chromatin cartoons introduce the biological target and are not additional preparative transformations. Adjacent scChIP-Seq drawings and partial scRC-Seq labels belong to neighboring rows. This record explains the depicted architecture and the paper-resolved compartment/barcode interfaces, without claiming identical complete implementations or adding unshown execution details.
